newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones index romps to another record high.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones index romps to another record high.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average Thursday charged into record ground for the third time this week as blue-chip stocks celebrated the good news that inflation was still not a threat to the economy.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow index jumped 76.19 points to 6,625.67, beating the last record close of 6,600.66 set on Tuesday. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines 16-9 on active volume of 556 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
